message: 神様の思し召し
Thanks to yesterday's study session, my brain's engine has finally started revving up, belated though it is.
Tomorrow is the actual test!

name: Paqy
message: 「Even so, you don't gotta go all the way to the Student Council room on a Sunday just to study by yourself, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I want a healthy sense of tension.」

name: Synn
message: 「When I study for the test at my place, I just keep remembering how much fun yesterday was.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I won't stop ya... but Yours Truly is gonna be just a regular stuffed animal for a while starting now, got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「...? Sure, that's fine?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh!?」
There might be someone already here. If anyone were to come study, it would probably be Misa. That's what I had imagined, so I was surprised to run into Azel and Lolotte instead.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, Mr. President. Good afternoon.」

name: Azel
message: 「I didn't want to come here because I figured someone would show up...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, are you two studying for the test?」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahem! I was giving a report to Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「I already understood. I've heard it over and over.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Things like this are fine to say as many times as you want.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「It depends on what it's about. If it's something wonderful, you naturally want to talk about it a lot.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a good thing, sparkle, sparkle~\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I had a fight with my friend, but thankfully we were able to make up without a hitch.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's fantastic. Congratulations!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪ I'm sorry for making you worry too, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I wasn't worried or anything!」

name: Azel
message: 「You dragged me all the way to a place like this, and that good news was your only business?」
Azel has a point. Why did she come here in the first place?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Exciting! Actually, the reason I came to the Student Council room is--」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauh!! Y-Yes you are~」

name: Azel
message: 「I said I am not. Your relationship has been repaired. Therefore, leave promptly!」
Azel isn't the one leaving, she's telling Lolotte to go home? That feels kind of weird.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thump-thump... To celebrate making up, we're going to make 'God's Miso Soup,' which has been passed down in this world since ancient times♪」

name: Azel
message: 「...Such a thing exists!?」
In stark contrast to Azel leaning forward with intense curiosity, I mentally analyze Lolotte's mistaken knowledge.
Hmm, if it's just a misunderstood proverb, I should be able to figure it out right away...

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's a portable stove in the Student Council room, so let's make it together, Azel-san.」

name: Azel
message: 「On this matter, I have no choice but to agree.」

name: Azel
message: 「So, how do we make it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have no idea!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Leave after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, hmm.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ryuusei Town is a seaside town. They have something called the afternoon catch, where fish caught during the day are sold, and they're super fresh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In my imagination, 'God's Miso Soup' is a delicious miso soup packed with seafood from the afternoon catch. There's no doubt about it.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Ah... Aah!? W-Wait a second! That's just mishearing 'God only knows'--」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!?」
J-Just now... Riesling-san aimed at me from outside...

name: Azel
message: 「You are well-versed in the preparation method of this so-called miso soup, are you not?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a basic of cooking for yourself so I know how, sure... but why are you asking on the assumption that I know?」

name: Azel
message: 「...No matter.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, to go shopping for miso and ingredients, all aboard~♪」
With Lolotte taking the lead, we ended up making 'God's Miso Soup.'
Glancing over, having finished the prep work and seemingly at a loose end, Azel was flipping through the albums of past Student Councils lined up on the bookshelf.

name: Synn
message: 「Even though it's the exact same Student Council room, the vibe is different, right? Each generation's personalities really shine through.」
I spouted a know-it-all line to Azel. Truth be told, I was just parroting Ria-senpai.

name: Azel
message: 「I can tell by looking.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be ready very soon♪ Excite, excite.」
In the Student Council room on a day off, the crisp scent of fresh-caught seafood mingled with piping-hot miso soup. The air filling the room was indescribably warm.
Even though it had nothing to do with Student Council duties, I couldn't help wondering if there had been officers in the past who cooked meals in this room just like this?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Time to dig in~♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Thanks for the food.」
The day before exams, the God's Miso Soup I made together with Azel and Lolotte in the Student Council room was seriously delicious.
...I want some white rice.
